method: Executed differential: the oracle driver links the Linux x86_64 Release install openms4-release-bc9cc12-c19e494-174b576 (g++ 14.4.0 -O2 -DNDEBUG, Arrow C++ 23.0.1) on ibminode06 and runs twice in a clean environment; both runs produced byte-identical records and files (results/differ.txt empty). The Rust tests replay the reader on every container the executed library wrote or read and compare field by field, and run the writer on the same inputs and compare every table value by value and metadata.json byte by byte except build_time. Both sections of TransitionParquetFile_test.cpp are transcribed.
evidence_tier: 1 (executed differential on the Release build; the class test transcribed as tier 2)
